headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Fresh Flurry; Stlican Shelf Goes Quiet
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest stirrings have moved to Weathered Expanse, which logged six strategic-base events in the latest two-hour window, thirteen in six, and twenty-three on the day, with casualties climbing on both sides. Stonecradle and DeadLands are also keeping the pace: Stonecradle posted two events in two hours, seven in six, and fifteen on the day, while DeadLands showed three in two, nine in six, and eighteen on the day. Stlican Shelf, still the day's most contested ground with forty-three events, went quiet in the last two hours after six in six. Godcrofts, previously reawakened, has cooled in the shortest window but shows two events in six and ten on the day, centered on Argosa. Callahan's Passage has not recorded another strategic-base event in the latest windows, though casualties there remain heavy; its last recorded event at The Latch came near eight o'clock. No victory has been declared.
